QuestInfo.name: [Azwan] The False Elixir 2
QuestInfo.0: Tell #bGardin#k at the #bAzwan Obelisk#k about what you learned at the Refugee Zone.
QuestInfo.1:
Gardin is happy the ghosts of Azwan will cooperate, is also just as confused as you about there being noElixir of Everlasting Youth. He says there is an #rElixir of Everlasting Youth being passed around in Ariant right now#k. If there is no elixir, what is it?

Go obtain an elixir in Ariant to get to the bottom of this.

#e#rIf you fail the quest, forfeit and start over.
QuestInfo.2: You obtained the Elixir of Everlasting Youth in Ariant. What is it really?

0.0: So the ghost of Azwan have agreed to help us, and Hilla is already on the loose in Maple World. You hit the information jackpot! I've got to tell the Alliance to keep a lookout for Hilla.
0.1: When I sent you off to look into those grave robbers, I never thought you'd find all this. I'll send some knights to investigate Azwan. But, boy am I glad you're on our side.
0.2: Anyway, I'm still confused about this Elixir of Everlasting Youth business. While you were gone, we got word that the Elixir of Everlasting Youth had shown up in Ariant's markets.
0.3: We looked into it and found out that #rsomething like the Elixir of Everlasting Youth#k really was traded there. But if what you said is true, what's really going on here?
0.4: Mind if I ask you to go get this elixir thing from Ariant? We already know where it is, you just need to go get it. So, you in?

no.0: If you have some other plan, I'm all ears.

1.0: So this the elixir, huh? Doesn't look all that special to me. We could send it off to Ereve for analysis, but that'll take too long...

item.0: Mind if I ask you to go get this elixir thing from Ariant? We already know where it is, you just need to go get it. So, you in?
